changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE formula_enteral ADD CONSTRAINT ck_formula_enteral_categoria CHECK (categoria IS NULL OR categoria IN ('Padrão', 'Hiperproteica', 'Diabetes', 'Peptídica', 'Imunomoduladora', 'Renal', 'Hepática'));

ALTER TABLE formula_enteral ADD CONSTRAINT ck_formula_enteral_positivos CHECK (densidade_kcal_ml > 0 AND proteina_g_l >= 0 AND (cho_g_l IS NULL OR cho_g_l >= 0) AND (lip_g_l IS NULL OR lip_g_l >= 0) AND (fibras_g_l IS NULL OR fibras_g_l >= 0) AND (agua_livre_perc IS NULL OR (agua_livre_perc > 0 AND agua_livre_perc <= 100)));

ALTER TABLE formula_enteral ADD CONSTRAINT ck_formula_enteral_fechamento CHECK ( cho_g_l IS NULL OR lip_g_l IS NULL OR abs((cho_g_l * 4 + proteina_g_l * 4 + lip_g_l * 9) - densidade_kcal_ml * 1000) <= densidade_kcal_ml * 1000 * 0.12 );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_formula_enteral_tenant_nome ON formula_enteral (tenant_id, lower(nome)) WHERE tenant_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_formula_enteral_global_nome ON formula_enteral (lower(nome)) WHERE tenant_id IS NULL;
